Read the complete original task, effective requirements and empty scope decisions, followed by every report line in continuous ranges 1–65, 66–130, 131–205 and 206–278. The opening provides a concrete organizing question—what later tasks inherit—and the first matrix identifies persistent objects before comparing scores. DGM transfer is explicitly attributed to a combined tool and additional-inference implementation; AlphaEvolve local and system-wide gains use different denominators; SCoRe separates first/second-attempt gains from a changed correction delta. Missing all-in costs and public optimizer access narrow the claims without erasing the documented gains. No required reader-understanding or decision-use defect found. Assessment uses the full supplied report and citation presentation; it does not claim fresh source verification or experimental replication.
